title: $env in an n8n Code node or expression returns 'access to env vars denied' after 2.0
symptoms: $env.MY_VAR worked in 1.x and fails after upgrading
Setting the variable on the main container has no effect with external task runners
cause: n8n 2.0 flipped N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE to true. With external task runners, Code node code runs in the runner container, so the setting and the variables must exist there too.
fix: Prefer credentials or Variables over env access. If you need it, set N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false on main and on the runner, and pass the variables to the runner container.
apply:
services:
  n8n:
    environment: [N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false]
  n8n-runners:
    environment: [N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false, MY_VAR=value]
affected: n8n 2.0 and later; a UI false positive persisted until 2.29.0
